description: Repairs r-ado-1b/book-raw-forms: the probe read Bookmark at MoveLast but not the current row, AbsolutePosition or RecordCount, so a server static Bookmark of 3 with RecordCount 7 cannot be explained. On SELECT ID, S FROM T ORDER BY ID (read-only copy of r-ado-1b-main), for a server forward-only, a server keyset, a server static and a client static read-only recordset: Supports(adBookmark); then at row 1, after MoveNext, after MoveLast, after MoveNext past the end (EOF read) and after MoveFirst then MovePrevious (BOF read), each position reads the current ID, AbsolutePosition, RecordCount and the raw Bookmark, with Connection.Errors read and cleared right after each position. Asks the Bookmark representation and the row, position and count it goes with.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
